_README: LindaAI Discord — per-channel command map (CUSTOMER DEFAULT).
This is the ONE file you edit to control which slash commands belong to which channel.
Each channel is fully ISOLATED: its commands only work in its channel, and its ask
command tells Claude to ONLY use that channel's skills (no crossings).
Out of the box you get TWO channels:
#deals    — the Sauce Underwriter: /underwrite (wholesale MAO + fix-and-flip P&L),
/flip, /comps. Paste a bare address with message triggers on and it
auto-underwrites.
#linda-ai — your general assistant: /brief /mail /followup /research.
Rename them, add channels for your own businesses, or move commands — just edit this
file and restart the bot. No code changes needed.
How channel matching works:
- The bot matches a Discord channel by NAME (case-insensitive, spaces/dashes ignored),
by CATEGORY (any channel/forum/thread under a matching category inherits the entry),
or by a hard-pinned channel ID. Priority: id > category > name.
Each channel has:
key            internal id (no spaces)
names          list of channel-name spellings that map here
id             OPTIONAL Discord channel ID override (left-click channel -> Copy Channel ID)
label          human label shown in replies
domain         one-line description Claude uses to stay in its lane
ask_command    the catch-all slash command for this channel (e.g. /deals <message>)
skills         the ONLY skills Claude may use in this channel (prevents crossings).
Skills you don't own are skipped with a startup warning — harmless.
quick_commands marquee one-shot slash commands unique to this channel
template       OPTIONAL on a quick_command: 'underwrite' or 'flip' pins that command
to the locked Sauce Underwriter prompt built into bot.py, so it works
even before any skills are installed.
auto_underwrite if true + ENABLE_MESSAGE_TRIGGERS=1, a BARE pasted address in this
channel auto-runs the underwriter (needs Message Content Intent).
auto_respond   if true + ENABLE_MESSAGE_TRIGGERS=1, plain messages from an owner in
this channel go to this channel's assistant.
allowed_users  restrict THIS channel to specific people — set
CHANNEL_ALLOWED_USERS_<KEY>=id1,id2 in ~/.claude/lindaai/discord.env
(never put personal IDs in this file). Empty = every owner.
category_names OPTIONAL list of CATEGORY names — best way to cover a whole area.

channels.label: Deals — Real Estate
channels.domain: real estate investing only: underwriting (wholesale MAO + fix-and-flip P&L via the Sauce Underwriter), rent & sales comps, deal analysis, offers, negotiation, pipeline. Not general assistant work (that's the Linda AI channel).

quick_commands.name: underwrite
quick_commands.description: Sauce Underwriter — wholesale MAO + fix-and-flip P&L (paste the address)
quick_commands.arg_desc: Property address (+ asking price / sqft / rehab level if you have them)

quick_commands.name: flip
quick_commands.description: Fix-and-flip analysis — full P&L if you flip it yourself
quick_commands.arg_desc: Address, purchase price, rehab budget/level, ARV if known

quick_commands.name: comps
quick_commands.description: Pull rent + sales comps for an address

channels.label: Linda AI — Assistant
channels.domain: general executive-assistant work only: email, follow-ups, research, briefings, inbox triage, SOPs. Do NOT do real-estate underwriting here (that's the Deals channel).

quick_commands.name: followup
quick_commands.arg_desc: Who to follow up with and context
